own_solution.law: Entropy is a state function. Melting contributes mLf/T0 and warming the liquid contributes mc ln(Tw/T0). Converting Lf to 334000 J/kg gives ΔS = 0.2(334000)/273 + 0.2(4186)ln(313/273) = 359.16 J/K.
assumptions: The initial ice is at the stated melting temperature of 273 K.
The stated latent heat and constant liquid heat capacity apply.
The system comprises the ice and its resulting meltwater, with no evaporative mass loss.
For the relevant added-mass sentences, the system includes the additional ice.
